zh.title: 連接埠狀態：open、closed 與 filtered 告訴你什麼？
zh.summary: 掃描輸出是特定時間、位置與方法下的觀察。先解讀回應，再決定下一個有授權的確認步驟。
objectives: 用觀測條件解釋不同掃描結果。
避免把開埠直接當成弱點或入侵證據。

sections.heading: 狀態描述探測看到的現象
paragraphs: 以 Nmap 的用語，open 表示該探測觀察到應用接受相關連線或資料；closed 表示目標可達但該埠沒有對應的監聽服務；filtered 表示封包過濾使工具無法確定是否開啟。請把狀態與探測協定一起讀。
open|filtered 這類複合狀態保留不確定性，不能自行刪去 filtered。工具顯示的狀態並非永遠固定的主機屬性；位置、時間、過濾規則與方法都會影響結果。

sections.heading: 把證據鏈分成四步
paragraphs: 第一步是網路可達；第二步是埠狀態；第三步是服務識別；第四步才是特定資源、設定或弱點的驗證。每一步需要自己的回應證據，後面的結論不能由前一步的標籤自動產生。
例如 443/tcp open 可以支持該次探測看到監聽者，但尚未驗證網站身分、TLS 設定或應用程式授權。記錄埠號、協定、時間、位置與方法，才能合理比較前後測。

example.title: 例子：內外網看到不同結果
example.scenario: 同一個合成主機在 10:00 從測試網段看到 445/tcp open，從外部測試網段則是 filtered。
example.reasoning: 這可以與路徑上的存取控制一致，但還需規則與封包證據確認原因。不能把兩筆直接當成工具壞掉，也不能說外部一定沒有服務。
example.conclusion: 保留兩個觀測位置；下一步核對已授權的控制規則。

lab.title: 離線練習：替掃描摘要加上證據邊界
lab.environment: 只讀本文合成輸出，不執行掃描。
steps: 建立三列：22/tcp closed、443/tcp open、53/udp open|filtered。
每列寫一個可支持的觀察與一個不可支持的結論。
為 443 加上時間、來源網段與方法欄位；不知道的欄位標為未知。
lab.expected: 53/udp 不能確定為 open；443 不能直接證明網站安全；22 closed 不代表整台主機不存在。
lab.check: 能否解釋為什麼不能把三列直接加總為「三個弱點」？
lab.cleanup: 保存文字摘要即可，沒有系統變更。

en.title: Port states: what do open, closed and filtered tell you?
en.summary: A scan result is an observation made at a particular time, vantage point and with a particular method. Interpret the response before choosing an authorized follow-up.
objectives: Explain differing results using observation conditions.
Avoid equating an open port with a vulnerability or compromise.

sections.heading: States describe what the probe can observe
paragraphs: In Nmap terminology, open indicates an application accepting the relevant connections or data. Closed indicates reachability without a corresponding listener. Filtered means packet filtering prevents a determination of whether the port is open. Read the state together with the probe protocol.

A combined state such as open|filtered preserves uncertainty; do not silently discard “filtered.” A tool’s state is not an immutable host property. Vantage point, time, filtering and method can affect the result.

sections.heading: Separate four steps in the evidence chain
paragraphs: Separate network reachability, port state, service identification and verification of a particular resource, configuration or weakness. Each step requires its own response evidence. A later conclusion does not arise automatically from an earlier label.

For example, 443/tcp open supports the presence of a listener in that observation. It has not verified website identity, TLS configuration or application authorization. Record port, protocol, time, vantage and method before comparing runs.

example.title: Example: different internal and external views
example.scenario: At 10:00, a synthetic host is observed as 445/tcp open from one test network and filtered from an external test network.
example.reasoning: The results are compatible with path-based access controls, but rules and packet evidence are needed to confirm the cause. They do not by themselves indicate a broken tool or prove that the external view has no service.
example.conclusion: Keep both vantage points and check the authorized control configuration.

lab.title: Offline exercise: bound a scan summary
lab.environment: Read the synthetic output only; do not run a scan.
steps: Create three rows: 22/tcp closed, 443/tcp open and 53/udp open|filtered.
Write one supported observation and one unsupported conclusion for each row.
Add time, source network and method fields to 443; mark missing values unknown.
lab.expected: 53/udp is not definitely open; 443 does not establish a secure website; 22 closed does not mean the host is absent.
lab.check: Can you explain why the three rows cannot be counted as three vulnerabilities?
lab.cleanup: Save the text summary; no system state was changed.

zh.prompt: 443/tcp open 直接支持哪個結論？
options: 此探測看到接受連線的服務
rationales: 安全性尚未驗證。
這符合此狀態的觀測意義。
開埠沒有提供權限證據。
埠狀態不是憑證驗證結果。

options: This probe observed a service accepting connections
rationales: Security has not been established.
This matches the state’s observational meaning.
An open port provides no evidence of privilege.
A port state is not a certificate-validation result.

options: 保留兩種可能及探測條件
rationales: 刪掉 filtered 會把不確定性變成確定。
沒有支持 closed 的結果。
保留不確定性才符合工具輸出。
狀態不提供入侵證據。

options: Preserve both possibilities and probe conditions
rationales: Dropping filtered falsely removes uncertainty.
The result does not support closed.
Preserving uncertainty matches the output.
The state is not compromise evidence.

zh.prompt: 比較兩次掃描前，最需要一起保留的是？
options: 時間、來源位置、協定與方法
把不同方法都視為完全相同
rationales: 這些條件影響可見回應。
圖示無法重建探測。
埠號不能代表完整觀測條件。
方法差異可能影響狀態判讀。

en.prompt: What should be retained when comparing scans?
options: Time, vantage point, protocol and method
rationales: These conditions affect observable responses.
An icon cannot reconstruct the probe.
A port number does not capture the observation conditions.
Different methods can change interpretation.
